atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work

facts.title: loss of containment at G-8101 during an intrusive maintenance task

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control FIRE_WATCH_PROVISION: the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control GAS_TEST_BEFORE_AND_DURING_HOT_WORK: the atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch on G-8101, G-8103 and TT-8101 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining hazardous-area electrical equipment, specifically inspecting Ex equipment and enclosures. G-8101 (gas turbine generators) is in service for on-site generation. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch had degraded below its design intent. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 29 October 2013 an incident occurred on G-8101, G-8103 and TT-8101 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during an intrusive maintenance task, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
